subject: general
question: Who discovered the antibiotic penicillin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alexander Fleming.**__

 
• **Penicillin fungi** are the source of penicillin.
 
• People take this antibiotic either orally or through injection.
 
• **Alexander Fleming **was the one who discovered Penicillin.
 
• It is not humans who are attaining resistance against the antibiotic, rather the bacteria.
 
• It is not because the bacteria is absorbing the antibiotic that they are becoming resistant to it.
